summary_1line: King Kusika witnesses a miraculous celestial palace and paradise conjured by the sage Chyavana, which then vanishes to reveal the ascetic’s yogic power.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Kusika and his queen stand before a vast golden palace with a thousand gem-studded pillars rising in a magical forest by the Ganga.
A lush enchanted woodland filled with apsaras, gandharvas, jeweled beds, blooming trees, and birds surrounds shining lakes under a radiant sky.
The sage Chyavana lies on a jeweled bed inside the golden hall, then suddenly vanishes along with the palace, leaving only a quiet riverbank with kusa grass and anthills.
